00dc5659057bb703745bdadb.text: Select Mark as duplicate: the Ticket becomes Duplicated, and leaves the queue.

020b78907947d31acdd47331.text: The dialog shows the automatic priority and what it is based on, then each priority with its meaning.

043f6f98bf8bbb74d9e01c45.text: Select Dismiss to close the message.

0601636641ff59bb9e55e3f3.text: The Ticket opens on its Overview, below its status and priority: its CVE, its packages, and its details.

090a9a5edc4da279733b098c.text: Select P2, to remediate with high urgency.

09bd6c5bc47b41352816fa44.text: Select Show hidden to see the hidden records.

0b5fdd68c0c4771132c84ad9.text: Select Clear filters: it removes the search and the filters, and keeps the view and its sorting.

0bb6bb6576c5295da7617acc.text: Here, Sentinel created the Ticket from its CVE, and added the maintainers of its packages.

0d544e653aa9682d69b003d7.text: In the package tree, Needs your action marks the track of your package that waits for your submission.

0db3207a9d89621ad1970c23.text: Select Filters to narrow the events by actor, by kind, or by period.

10697e1ea19c2fb39c5bf7ec.text: The heading row gives SUSE's status for the CVE: this Ticket is Resolved.

10eb5bb60fe87d8647e73a43.text: The heading row now shows P2, still marked as an override.

1356c596be7521bd762ca02f.text: Select Access grants, next to the participants, to let another user see the Ticket.

14b8991c6696ebb4930a4341.text: Select Clear filters to remove the search.

162ae835217d4f015f4e26a1.text: Taking a new Ticket moves it to Analysis, and out of the queue.

1aab47d6e1312b325fc9b9c4.text: Select Tickets in the sidebar to return to the queue.

1ae4b60c9fe41136148e728f.text: Select Embargo expired to list the Tickets whose Coordinated Release Date has passed, and that are still confidential.

1b247fa8f2a0c8942043ee4e.text: Select Ignore to stop working the Ticket, with a reason.

1e6155e494e0a806fd1e0651.text: Press Enter to keep the Tickets of the view that match.

27e0c613868403371054e722.text: Select Override priority to change it.

2899a7560788e1be15afe1df.text: Select Edit assignee, the pencil next to Unassigned in the details, to take the Ticket.

28b703767a885ad35e8d01ea.text: The Ticket now has its CVE, and no severity until the CVE has a CVSS assessment.

28c16733914a2c9deb5e6fa1.text: Select Severity, or the heading of another sortable column, to sort the list by it.

2b60e02d6c1f925995db0482.text: Open the first Ticket of the queue by selecting its identifier.

2e6a18a2d852ccc6f65ff76b.text: The priority of this Ticket, P1, is an override: it replaces the automatic priority until someone clears it.

2e6fc3deb491ca40e596e72d.text: A lock and the label Confidential now mark the Ticket.

316c6d7f30e7d433a022482c.text: The grant shows below, with who granted it and when, and Revoke access to end it.

3455cb9825a48544af5e3132.text: Open the view Embargo for the confidential Tickets, sorted by Coordinated Release Date, the earliest first.

3539b78ba6bf10fd13f205a4.text: Select Add reference: the reference joins the table, with the source Manual.

357ec1ee2e8b6b1051f2e7ca.text: Select Analysis, a value of the status filter: the list follows at once.

35b6ca9986180c1e1c6a76ba.text: Open the tab Audit log for the history of the Ticket, the newest events first.

3b38e324f988843f579101f3.text: Here, the priority is an override: the explanation shows who set it and when, and the automatic priority that it replaces.

429ca952c5ddd715c13a33a0.text: Open another Ticket of the queue.

43249056e8a2da54f69d4d27.text: Open a link that a colleague shares: it keeps the view, the search, and the filters, so you see the same list.

432c771bd426b3c8d7fcfe98.text: Select the phases of its track, the circles of its pipeline, to follow the delivery.

43a01a07160ae43327ec87d3.text: Select Edit Coordinated Release Date, the pencil in the details, when the parties agree on another date.

4473b9e2ee838a952e7fe7b2.text: Add package then adds it, with the tracks and Products that Sentinel finds for it in SMELT.

460e344555503fc2b8b3dabb.text: The views are tabs, and each counts its Tickets. New and Unassigned are the queues of the Tickets that wait for an analyst; Analysis, Analyzed, and All follow.

4890a0e8895617e3f9599df1.text: In every view, a lock after its identifier marks a confidential Ticket.

4d2a7e08cfca5fdad17d86d0.text: Select Save: Sentinel calculates the severity again from the new vector.

5170dd378d6016b5a4330248.text: The embargo of this Ticket ends at its Coordinated Release Date, and its deadlines lead up to that date.

519750206ac9cb8c893d25fc.text: On a new Ticket, the menu starts with Ignore, Ignore as not shipped by SUSE, and Mark as duplicate.

51b14610bc9c0fc32c835f56.text: Press Escape to close the filters.

5870d6af322e61231c76c4b3.text: Select System for what Sentinel did by itself.

5ac76fe9f92da1395348a3c6.text: Select Critical: the severity decides the deadlines and the automatic priority.

5d84ae6c5dc8168c679202a4.text: Open the view Unassigned for the Tickets in Analysis or Analyzed that wait for an assignee.

5e97d09fe73938449fa00dfe.text: Select the phases of the track, the circles of its pipeline, for their deadlines: here, the submission is overdue.

6004e87552687ba31c872ad4.text: Enter the name of a package: the search finds Tickets by their identifier, their CVE, or their packages.

607d30a6f13ed4bdadc9b55b.text: Enter the original, such as one of its packages.

60af882a84f0e5ac2aaa022f.text: This other Ticket of one of your packages has your fix submitted, and its delivery in progress.

6e229045f7a8dae7388184d4.text: Select Actions, at the end of the heading row.

6e6c39f6de0f852ad0c902be.text: Below the field, Aura names your time zone, and the same instant in UTC, as the parties often state it.

6e6c40756f21edff79c08803.text: Select Make non-confidential to disclose it.

6f72946712b3d0db08630eb4.text: Select yourself, first in the list: the Ticket is now assigned to you.

709ffa983c0166a312c2ee57.text: Select Submission, or another count, to list its Tickets in the All view.

734b34ac5985cb9ba28f7a1c.text: Enter the name of the user.

7a962ac5c42927d0c0a9718c.text: Open the Ticket by selecting its identifier.

7d31cf5d1df95321242943d5.text: Select Actions, at the end of the heading row, to place the Ticket under embargo.

7e3585aac3e68326d57e03e0.text: Select Actions, at the end of the heading row, for what you can do with the Ticket.

836e8337fabf12ed6e4c2c13.text: Select the actions of the package again.

845a33a6f33a8fed9d0c96ba.text: The deadlines of the Ticket follow the new date, which they lead up to.

849e2b2964c62b9111da2f43.text: Select None for Availability: the vector and the Base score follow.

84f75ddcd08b0dc9be2068c5.text: The field suggests the Tickets that match by identifier, by CVE, or by package.

864498c1f782ba0d68c396df.text: The tree hides the package, and a message says so.

8984e18b08aa8f6277c83c5e.text: Press Enter to keep the events that match.

89cc83c7717fc1daf3c96478.text: Submission shows your latest submission request in IBS, as a link to it; the plus counts the earlier ones.

8a41c474a9e3f821848d0f78.text: Select Restore to include it again.

909369362fb216ea1dce7f75.text: Press Space to choose Not shipped, the first reason.

90fe96322b1d7b23f8de7a03.text: Select Mark as duplicate to name the Ticket that it duplicates.

915e2670ad2ab077583edfc7.text: Next to the heading, the attention summary counts the Tickets that need attention: the active P1 Tickets, and the Tickets overdue in each phase, from Triage to QA.

957812851d66d2b9dea2426c.text: Select Make confidential, the last item of the menu.

97636cc51facc711884a81ec.text: Select Save: the Ticket is now Critical, with the automatic priority P2.

9d069cfc971f8016c31d232c.text: Select QA, or another overdue count of the attention summary, to find late work in the All view.

9d906a997b94e4e227c4fab6.text: Select Edit SUSE assessment, the pencil on its row, to change its vector.

9f31f8cd1d733749b273ee2a.text: Its details gain the field Coordinated Release Date, the end of the embargo, empty until you set it.

9fbc9d10e90c55e776390d49.text: Its details link to the original. Revert duplicate, in Actions, undoes the change.

a1758f1460b1e3946205a608.text: Open the link that an analyst shares with you: it leads to the Ticket.

a2278fab73fb90c65683e00a.text: Here, the link searches for a package and keeps the Analyzed Tickets.

a290ccc686f07735f3bd9a29.text: No action removes a CVE from a Ticket, so Aura asks first, and says what changes.

a2de13403341b267aedb6e60.text: Below the CVE, each package of the Ticket lists its tracks, and each track its Products, with its phases and its affectedness.

a373ad9aedbb1a2a519136dc.text: Select Associate CVE once the issue of the Ticket has a CVE.

a444935bb3b8d92151d08706.text: Enter a title, which the table shows above the address.

a562048eab336815a11fffc9.text: Open the view Assigned to me to see your Tickets in Analysis or Analyzed.

a6fb555ba70cb015658ea0f9.text: Without a CVE, the menu adds Set severity and Associate CVE.

a824bb8b804bba80820d64cb.text: Press the Down arrow to move the day earlier, or type the date and time agreed.

a9a815e13289975e44326741.text: Open the tab References for the advisories, patches, and other pages about the Ticket.

abf7459f5f166715ba308245.text: Select Analyzed too, to keep the Tickets that have either status.

ade525849e2503b61d0cd359.text: Select Ignore: the Ticket becomes Ignored, and leaves the queue.

b1a0fc3ffd50ed96e02c40df.text: Open a third Ticket of the queue.

b3d9c8fb788d84ac06cbbb79.text: Its release says Released, with the date of the release.

b622366ea26141b5d84b7447.text: Select Edit reference, the pencil on its row, to change it.

b6a5f069b0898ef78b24ee98.text: The most severe Tickets now come first; selecting the heading again reverses the order.

b80c60f90d1658be96cad971.text: Each reason says when it applies: Not shipped, when SUSE ships none of the affected software, or Other.

b872c43fbabf232116739f33.text: Aura says who keeps seeing the Ticket: the users who see every Ticket, and the maintainers of its packages that are not excluded.

bbf82a5973d7d22dada905ed.text: Select Save: the description shows below the address.

be04d7a5bde2df671ee0ed81.text: Select the priority of a Ticket to see its explanation.

bfe54d1683709a514add2f53.text: Select Tickets again to return to the queue.

c0fbd589f3bb47ffd7cb0141.text: Select Not affected when the issue doesn't affect the track: it has no work left.

c1b1c77394d6409065cc9c03.text: Select Actor: it lists System, then the users who acted on the Ticket.

c4e041b3c93fff4ce22e8cd3.text: Enter the address of the page.

c549a1b6be1b25eb818de941.text: Select a Product for its eligibility, its lifecycle, its release, and its actions.

c6650f6bafdff7ee654259a9.text: Aura asks first: every user can then see the Ticket, which can't be undone, and its access grants are deleted.

c989d8bdade9e43f27d07c49.text: Enter the CVE ID: the search finds Tickets by their identifier, their CVE, or their packages.

cafbc747d963a64e216d3c5e.text: The package tree shows each package of the Ticket, its tracks, each an IBS codestream or a Git branch, and their Products: here, the track is Fixed.

cb68500f0966013ea9a2848d.text: Select Delete reference to confirm, since it can't be undone.

ce5ebd9cf4a4a01cd75db890.text: Select Type: Detect from the address leaves the type to Sentinel.

ced0a06e76455ee97515ecaf.text: Each event says who changed what, and when: a user, or System for what Sentinel did by itself.

d336b3b73b0935df8a3c2a01.text: Enter a value, such as a package: the search looks in the values that the events record.

d73b89e5d2997acac44ca9d7.text: This Ticket, created by hand, has no CVE, so you set its severity.

d8109c7ed4eb649a6d818713.text: Select Filters to narrow the list.

d811b7ce199165b61d8fa682.text: A queue is sorted by priority, then by deadline, so its most urgent Ticket comes first.

d97be4283c95f79fca98b301.text: The field suggests the source packages that SMELT maintains whose names match.

dc0854fa5408fdc2ebd16a27.text: Select a Product to see whether its fix is released.

decf13eb744494622b86e223.text: In the list, the Deadline column shows the next deadline of a Ticket, in red once it has passed.

e153d5d4a735214d874fc73a.text: Select Exclude when the package doesn't concern the Ticket.

e862f806ceb1cd79cf646946.text: Open the view All to return to every Ticket.

e89d5cb8d0e886c254302107.text: Each reference shows its type, its source, and when it was added: Manual marks those that you and other analysts add.

ea071bc5e62cdbf55e769b59.text: Select Delete reference, the trash can on its row, to remove it.

ea3d3044ace6c0916c226d49.text: Select Patch to set the type yourself.

ebef5e199826b316480f528d.text: As an analyst, you land on the New view, the queue of the new Tickets that no analyst has taken yet.

ec6afb983cc8cf3741bb0fc0.text: Sentinel Aura opens the Ticket list in its All view: every Ticket that you can see, the most recently modified first.

f1415e5e280e22562cbe865a.text: The label Excluded marks the package that you excluded.

f1452a5255dbda6f839ecb1f.text: Select the actions of a package, the three dots at the end of its band.

f42092d3257f92458b5c3b87.text: Select Make non-confidential: the lock goes, and the Coordinated Release Date stays in the details.

f76dae8691fdf7b02c2811c1.text: Its details show the reason. Reopen, in Actions, returns the Ticket to work.

f845de294684a805e8b1e591.text: Select Add package when Sentinel missed a package of the Ticket.

f9960020b65bb08e1398dd92.text: Open the view Analysis to see the Tickets in that status, sorted by priority, then by deadline.

f9ca9bd8e0b256d8658fc042.text: The field lists the active users who match.

fce3efd04843710c0531dc00.text: The SUSE assessment of the CVE sets the severity of the Ticket, and the eligibility score of the Products.

febd53c63743e2fbc58da98d.text: Select the affectedness of a track to change it.
